On the admissible record, aggregate readiness and no sev-one rehearsal incidents are the main positive facts. The unresolved problem is that policy text requires either no current material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion; the draft runbook does not satisfy that standard on its face, and the model-card draft appears inconsistent with the known Spanish billing limitation. The most defensible posture is therefore to certify while accurately rating evidentiary support as weak.
